similarityReview: The reconstruction captures the massive, gnarled trunk of the ancient olive tree using multiple cylinders and prisms to simulate the irregular, twisted bark texture. The canopy is represented by a large, complex cluster of ellipsoids to mimic the dense, sprawling olive foliage. The stone retaining wall base is modeled with boxes to match the masonry structure. The scale is anchored to the human figure (1.8m) standing at the base.
